description: Read a web page as clean markdown and screen it for prompt injection in one call, before your agent puts it in context. Returns the markdown plus verdict safe, suspicious or malicious, a 0-100 score and matched spans. Respects robots.txt. Price $0.005 USDC per call via x402. Example output: {"url":"https://example.com/","status":200,"title":"Example Domain","characters":156,"injection":{"verdict":"safe","score":0,"categories":{},"matches":[]},"markdown":"This domain is for use in documentation examples..."}
